notes: Author a rule set plus a CLI monitor that emits an alert summary JSON (timestamp + alerts with id/severity/matches/ips) and a report JSON (events + per-rule statistics map). Medium: dependent artifacts (rules -> run -> both outputs), exact two-schema contract, default-argument behavior, and scan-order event emission. Adversarial: unparseable/empty rule sets, rules with missing id/metric/max/threshold/severity, non-object entries, malformed log lines, missing/empty log files. Verifier recomputes the visible case from scratch and reruns the program on three hidden rule/log combinations against pinned expecteds.
